description: Na₃SnCPO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.78 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.62 Å. Sn is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Sn-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.55 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.29-1.32 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are two shorter (1.56 Å) and two longer (1.57 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sn, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na and one C atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₃C tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Na, one Sn, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sn, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Sn, and one P atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₂SnP tetrahedra. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one P atom.
